items.title: Carolyn Buck Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: Naturally, he liked Lawrence Moreiro. But Lawrence is gone.

ctx.x: Did he have any special favorites among the musicians or did he say anything about that?

Well, as far as favorites, there were no special favorites. Naturally, he liked Lawrence Moreiro. But Lawrence is gone. And he was getting a little bit displeased with the musicians toward the end because he was a perfectionist in his playing. George wanted everything to be just so. He really was a born leader when it came to a band. And it hurt him deeply when he became ill and couldn't lead, couldn't be a leader. I mean, he turned that down himself because he felt it wasn't fair to the group that since he…
Yeah, well, it's just better not playing again.
